dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: I wonder, are Miss Kiyoko's goods too cheap...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Isn't it better if the prices are affordable?

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: Well, for people like us who rely on her for the purchase of daily necessities, the cheaper the better.

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: In the beginning, the prices were so low that everyone suspected that she might have ulterior motives... Now that I think of it, that was uncalled-for behavior on our part.

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: Miss Kiyoko truly is friendly and good-hearted, having given up higher profit margins so that she could give us more conveniences and better living standards.

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: Thanks to her, everyone in the village can buy goods easily and can sometimes even get some new and interesting things.

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: Speaking of that, I did buy some new fabrics some time back. Once my husband gets back, I'll make him some new clothes...

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: My husband is a soldier in the Sangonomiya forces. He's currently stationed near Yashiori Island.

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: I'm not all too familiar with the situation out there. My husband's letters don't mention the war at all. His letters are full of assurances that he's well and that there's no need to worry...

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: But to tell the truth, how can I not worry about him, as his wife?

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: *sigh* I miss the days when we had no such cares. When times got busy, we would be busy together. When we were free, we would watch the flowers together...

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: May Watatsumi Omikami watch over my husband and ensure his safe return.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope that you'll meet again soon.

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, I have some food that I made here. I was going to give them to Miss Kiyoko, but you can have some too.

dialogues.speaker: Momoko
dialogues.text: It's just an ordinary meal, but if you don't mind, please give it a try.
